⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE ⚠️
This is the Dolma 3.5 pool. It contains no quality upsampling or mixing. This is an updated version of the Dolma 3 pool with additional quality filtering and more data sources.
If you are interested in the data used to train Olmo 3 7B and Olmo 3 32B, visit allenai/dolma3_mix-6T-1025. 


	
		
	
	
		Dolma 3.5 Pool
	

The Dolma 3.5 pool is a dataset of nearly 10 trillion tokens from a diverse mix of web content, academic publications, code, and more. For detailed… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/dolma3.5_pool.
